messages:
zoe: Quick sync: Product approved a canary-first rollout for the v1 -> v2 migration. We need doc-side controls: snippet lint, CI snippet-runner, banner copy, and a docs feature-flag that can be toggled per-region. Can I get volunteers?

hannah: I'll own the feature-flag and banner copy. Thinking of a per-region flag like `docs.migrate_banner_eu=true`. Keeps ops in control.

ricardo: I'll add a docs-lint rule to catch old param names and v1 endpoints. Also propose a small annotation in PRs that lists changed snippets so reviewers can focus.

zoe: good. For snippet CI, we need: (1) no real keys, (2) run snippets against a mock server, (3) fail the PR with clear annotations pointing to the code block.

ci-bot: Suggested GH Action job:
```
jobs:
  snippet-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: scripts/setup-mock-server.sh &
      - run: ./scripts/run-snippets.sh --annotate-fails
```

ricardo: `run-snippets.sh` can return lines like `SNIPPET_FAIL: docs/guides/migrate.md:line:57` so the GH annotation points exactly. We'll add that to the docs-lint output too.

hannah: banner language: short and neutral. Draft: "Planned deprecation: v1 API. Migrate to v2 by 2026-05-15. Learn more: /docs/v2/migrate". Will wire this behind flags per-region.

zoe: ops needs a canary plan: enable banner+302 redirect for 1% traffic in staging region, monitor error rates and `deprecated=v1` hits for 48h, then expand to 10% then 100%. Also a rollback toggle to disable redirects if we see issues.

ops: Created ticket OPS-5591: docs-canary-rollout. Includes steps: enable flag, deploy nginx 302 rule, smoke test, monitor.

ricardo: PR checklist items to add automatically via template: snippet-ci green, docs-lint clean, feature-flag entry present, ops ticket linked. If any fail, block merge.

zoe: also add a short rollback snippet for ops in the PR:
```
# rollback nginx: remove /docs/v1 -> /docs/v2/compat rewrite
sudo ./deploy-router-config --rollback docs-v1-redirect
```

hannah: for localized banners, I'll add strings for en/fr/de/ja and include the exact migration date phrasing per legal. PR soon.

ci-bot: PR opened by @ricardo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/7777  adds docs-lint rule + snippet-runner GH Action.

zoe: nice. can you also ensure the snippet-runner emits an analytics test event `docs.migration.snippet_check` so we can track snippet failures over time?

ricardo: yes. runner will emit a fake telemetry event to the mock endpoint and CI will assert it was called at least once.

ops: once PR merges, we'll schedule a canary enable for 2026-04-10 03:00 UTC. Keep thread updated when PR passes CI.

zoe: final checklist here in thread:
- [ ] banners + i18n PR merged
- [ ] docs-lint + snippet CI merged (#7777)
- [ ] feature-flag entries created
- [ ] OPS-5591 canary deploy executed (1% -> 10% -> 100%)
- [ ] analytics `deprecated=v1` and `docs.migration.snippet_check` observed

hannah: I'll ping legal about the exact date phrasing.

ricardo: will follow up with a small unit in go/python/sdk to ensure we document the auth header trim tip: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and show `strings.TrimSpace` example for Go.

zoe: thanks everyone. Please post PR links and OPS ticket updates here so I can close the migration epic when rollout completes. :rocket:
